item.text:
This module provides small order helpers for a shop backend in [test/orders.js](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-J014pF/test/orders.js): it calculates cart totals, applies coupon discounts, computes an average item price, and formats an order into display text.

Bugs:
- [test/orders.js:5](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-J014pF/test/orders.js:5) `for (let i = 0; i <= items.length; i++)` iterates one step too far. On the last iteration `items[i]` is `undefined`, so `items[i].price` throws.
- [test/orders.js:20](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-J014pF/test/orders.js:20) `averageItemPrice` divides order total by `items.length`, but `calcTotal` is quantity-weighted. For `qty > 1`, this returns average per line item, not average per item unit. If the intent is true average item price, it should divide by total quantity.
- [test/orders.js:21](C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-J014pF/test/orders.js:21) `averageItemPrice` also divides by zero for an empty array, producing `NaN`/`Infinity` depending on upstream behavior.

If you want, I can also propose the minimal fix.
